metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented disposition for an acute seizure rescue-medication record using the available clinical materials.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
RECONCILIATION REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-3501
The evening neurology service asks that the rescue-medication timeline be addressed before transfer documentation is closed. Reference: SZR-V3-3501.
files./workspace/ehr/current.txt:
CURRENT ENCOUNTER
Patient ID: PAT-V3-3501
A signed emergency neurology order at 09:18 names lorazepam 4 mg IV once. The medication administration record has an entry at 09:21 labeled completed. Vital signs at 09:25 show improved motor activity.
files./workspace/ehr/history.txt:
EVENT HISTORY
The continuous EEG event log marks electrographic activity from 09:12 to 09:18 and a second annotation at 09:24 reading artifact versus recurrent activity. A prior admission included a documented paradoxical agitation reaction after benzodiazepine exposure.
files./workspace/ehr/evidence.txt:
DOCUMENTATION EVIDENCE
The infusion access flow sheet records an infiltrated peripheral line at 09:20 and a replacement line at 09:27. A nursing note drafted at 09:32 says medication was prepared during the access change; its author has not signed it. The MAR route field contains IV and no free-text clarification.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a reconciliation request, current encounter, event history, and documentation evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
